applyTo: "shared/**"

## Cross-BU shared code

Changes here affect Aquaculture, Livestock, and Food Manufacturing pipelines.
- Require explicit justification in the PR description for why the shared schema/util is being changed.
- Flag if the PR does not mention which downstream BUs were checked for impact.
- Do not approve silently — always leave a comment listing which BU paths depend on the changed file.
